senses.gloss: (= לחלח) to moisten; to season by dipping into vinegar &c.
units: <cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 5:6">Ruth R. to II, 14</cite> (v. <cite ref="L00551"><he>לִכְלוּךְ</he></cite>) <he>של׳ מעשיו כחומץ ממעשים רעים</he> he (Manasseh) amended his conduct as if with vinegar (freeing it) from bad deeds.—Part. pass. <he>מְלוּכְלָךְ</he>, f. <he>מְלוּכְלֶכֶת</he>; pl. <he>מְלוּכְלָכִים</he>; <he>מְלוּכְלָכוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 3:1:4">Y. Ḥag. III, 78ᵈ</cite> <he>מל׳ במשקה</he> dipped in liquid, contrad. to <he>מלוא משקה</he>, opp. to <he>נגיב</he>. Y. Sabb. XII, 16ᵇ top <he>אם מל׳ במשקה</he> if the cane is saturated with oil.
<cite ref="Keritot 13a:45">Ker. 13ᵃ</cite> <he>טיפה מל׳ על וכ׳</he> the drop with which the nipple is moistened; a. e.

<cite ref="Midrash Mishlei 11:3">Midr. Prov. to XI, 22</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 944">Yalk. Prov. 944</cite> (ref. to Prov. l. c.) <he>אם … היא מְלַכְלְכוֹ בטיט</he> if thou puttest a golden ornament on the nose of a swine, it will soil it with mud &c.; <he>כך ת״ח … מְלַכְלֵךְ את תורתו</he> so does a scholar … soil his learning; (Midr. Prov. l. c. <he>מקלקל</he>).—Part. pass. as ab.
<cite ref="Yoma 77b">Yoma 77ᵇ</cite> <he>היו ידיו מלוכלכות וכ׳</he> Ms. M. 2 (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 100) if his hands are soiled &c.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 65">Gen. R. s. 65</cite> <he>הייתי משמשו בבגדים מל׳</he> I used to attend him in soiled (working) garments.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 22">Ex. R. s. 22</cite>, end (ref. to <cite ref="Job 16:17">Job XVI, 17</cite>) <he>מי שידיו מל׳ בגזל וכ׳</he> he whose hands are soiled with robbery, will call … but not be answered.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 27">Ex. R. s. 27</cite>, end <he>מל׳ בעבירות</he> soiled with sins.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 1">Lev. R. s. 1</cite>, v. <cite ref="A02514"><he>אִסְפַּקְלַרְיָא</he></cite>; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to be moistened, flavored. Pesik. B’shall., p. 92ᵇ מִתְלַכְלְכִין היו וכ׳ (not מתלכלין) they were perfumed with the moisture of the herbs &c.; v. גִּעְגֵּעַ; Yalk. Deut. 850.
to be soiled. Y. B. Kam. III, 3ᶜ נִתְלַכְלְכוּ כליו (not נתכלכלו; Bab.
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 30a">B. Kam. 30ᵃ</cite> <he>נטנפו</he>) if his garments were soiled.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 65:15">Gen. R. s. 65</cite> <he>מִתְלַכְלֵךְ בעוונות</he> defiles himself with sins.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 23">Ex. R. s. 23</cite>; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:5:4">Cant. R. to I, 5</cite> <he>מִתְלַכְלֶכֶת</he>, v. <cite ref="K00067"><he>כָּבַס</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 6:5">Esth. R. to II, 7</cite> <he>נִתְלַכְלַכְתִּי בטומאה</he> I became soiled with impurity; a. e.
